name: DOC_RAG_FINANCE_BENCHMARK_FILTERED
description: A filtered document retrieval-augmented-generation (RAG) benchmark focused on finance: measures how well retrieval+generation pipelines answer finance-domain queries using provided documents. It evaluates the ability to retrieve relevant passages and produce accurate, grounded answers for real-world finance questions. The dataset is intended for assessing RAG systems and retrieval quality in a financial context.
reputation: Niche Hugging Face dataset used in RAG/finance experiments with limited but growing community use.
